messages:
Rina: holy moly — dashboard just hit 160M ARR. heart is racing. tiny celebration today? bagels, a mini garage-band (Omar volunteered), and bonsai giveaway? :tada: :bagel:

Omar: i'll bring my uke and a kazoo. low-effort high-joy setlist. :musical_note: :ukulele:

Gabe: congrats y'all. shoutout to Li and release for the midnight patch. impressed. :raised_hands:

Li: logistics: rooftop free at 5:30. vendor okayed a bagel bar with vegan and gluten-free options. Ops-bot will confirm.

Sasha: tiny poll  react with :bagel: for bagels, :cupcake: for pastries. also drop diet notes if needed. poll ends in 10m.

Ops-bot: Event created: "160M Bagels & Bonus Beats" 5:30600PM Rooftop. Capacity: 30. Catering note: bagel bar + coffee. (automated)

Rina: love the energy. grant idea: plant-a-bonsai for each engineer who shipped this quarter? small budget but symbolic. thoughts?

Omar: gifting bonsai = instant office zen. i'll play a calming tune while people pick theirs.

Gabe: Meme drop: "me staring at logs -> sees 160M" [img] :joy:

Li: counternote: parking near loading dock reserved for caterer at 5:15. if youre driving in, park in visitor and walk in.

Sasha: poll tally so far: :bagel: 12, :cupcake: 1. bagels win.

Rina: volunteers to help pack bonsai/little swag at 5:00? need 3 people.

Omar: i'll help. Gabe too.

Gabe: quick shoutouts in-thread so i can paste them in the post for the leadership email: i'll start  "huge props to release, infra, and docs for late-night heroics." :heart:

Li: "QA and bench team for catching the sticky case."

Sasha: "vendor ops for last-minute vegan save."

Rina: perfect — see you all at 5:30. bring a sweater and your smallest bonsai vibes. :herb:
